180000102.text: It has been a while since you joined the Adventurers' Guild. Are your adventures going smoothly?

180000105.text: Hmm... is that so? Apart from your own skills, reliable teammates are also indispensable when adventuring.

180000106.text: Another person to count on is always good, after all. But recruiting such dependable companions is no easy matter, is it?

180000107.text: Yup, and it's even harder to get a guide as good as Paimon.

180000108.text: Ah, yes, I do have some information that may be of help to you...

180000109.text: Let me consult our records... Ah, there it is. There's been a certain blond stranger who arrived in Mondstadt lately, dressed in most unusual clothes.

180000110.text: Blond... dresses all funny... It feels like Paimon's heard this one before...

180000113.text: #Does that stranger's face look... anything like {M#his}{F#hers}!?

180000114.text: Hmm? Like the Honorary Knight's? No, they couldn't look more different. This stranger is a very tall man, and even has an eyepatch...

180000115.text: So, just some distant relative of Kaeya's, then...

180000116.text: Seriously? How does this have anything to do with Kaeya? Eyepatches can't prove that you're related, anyway!

180000117.text: That stranger declined the Guild's invitation, so I can't say that I know anything about the relationship between him and Mr. Kaeya.

180000118.text: Nonetheless, you can look for him if you're interested. Perhaps he might accept your commission instead.

180000119.text: After all, it is not uncommon for some adventurers to not want to be limited by the Guild, but be happy to accept a fellow adventurer's requests.

180000120.text: And should this stranger be a strong adventurer indeed, he would certainly be a big help on your journey.

180000201.text: Ah, Honorary Knight. Is something the matter?

180000202.text: So, I'm looking for a stranger with an eyepatch...

180000203.text: A stranger with an eyepatch? Hmm... let me think. Oh yeah. I remember seeing someone like that. A blond stranger dressed in unusual garb.

180000204.text: He was wandering all over Mondstadt at first, which I found rather suspicious, so I decided to keep an eye on him for a while.

180000205.text: I lost him pretty quickly... Still, I didn't think that this was such a huge matter that we needed our Outrider to pursue him by air.

180000206.text: As long as Master Jean is here, there's nothing to fear from some suspicious, unusual-looking person.

180000207.text: That might be true, but if it were up to Jean, she'd take this way more seriously.

180000208.text: Haha, that is true. But on the other hand, knowing that Master Jean may overreact to the situation is all the more reason to not tell her, no?

180000209.text: Anyways... Oh, yeah! He was at Wagner's smithy for a while before I tried tailin' him. He might have said something to Wagner.

180000210.text: You should go ask him. Maybe he has more news about our stranger.

180000302.text: So, I'm looking for a stranger with an eyepatch...

180000303.text: I remember him. He showed up a few days ago, asking to buy a bunch of forging materials.

180000304.text: Can't say I've heard of any of the materials he mentioned, though.

180000305.text: He then had a look at the weapons in my shop before leaving. I've heard that he can be found drinking at the Angel's Share.

180000306.text: If the Knights or the Guild want to get a hold of him, that's the only place to be, haha.

180000307.text: The Angel's Share? Well, Master Diluc probably has his eye on that stranger too, then.

180000308.text: Anyway, let's go to the Angel's Share and have a look.

180000401.text: What will it be, grape juice or apple cider?

180000402.text: Another day, another lack of alcoholic options...

180000403.text: Hey Charles, have you seen a blond stranger who wears an eyepatch around here by any chance?

180000404.text: That I have. He comes here every night — just to drink, though. Doesn't order anything else.

180000405.text: He even sometimes mixes his own drinks after he orders them.

180000406.text: I don't know anything else about him, but from his selections and mixes, I'd say that he's quite the connoisseur.

180000408.text: Why, I just gave it to you — "quite the connoisseur."

180000409.text: Investigating everything as always — guess that's Diluc for you...

180000410.text: If you're looking for that gentleman, he ordered some new bottle of wine in advance yesterday, so he should be here today, too.

180000411.text: There's too many raucous patrons on the first floor, so if you want to wait, best to go to the second.

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the second floor of the tavern and wait on the seat by the railing

180000502.text: Hi, I'm an adventurer with the Adventurers' Guild.

180000504.text: How do you do? I'm an Honorary Knight of Favonius...

180000505.text: Wow, he's got no intention of paying us any mind, huh...

180000507.text: A traveler... you say? Hmph. Why are you traveling?

180000508.text: I'm looking for my lost relative.

180000510.text: Well, that's as good a reason as any... Sit down over there, then.

180000511.text: So... guess we've broken the ice... What a weird guy.

180000512.text: Hmm. That little one beside you...

180000514.text: That's not true, and you know it!

180000517.text: It's indeed a good thing to have someone accompany you on your travels.

180000518.text: My name's Dainsleif. I suppose you have some business with me?

180000519.text: Well, I was hoping to invite you to adventure with us...

180000522.text: (And he was so cold just a moment before... Paimon's got a baaaad feeling about this!)

180000523.text: But I will require advance payment.

180000516.text: Uh-huh, we're the best of friends!

180001301.text: Ah, welcome, sir. The wine that you previously ordered is here.

180001302.text: He's really here!? Let's go downstairs and have a look.

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the first floor of the tavern and find the stranger

180003601.text: #As I thought... you really are similar to {M#her}{F#him}.

180003803.text: I'll take that 500 Mora... and now I also understand your views on this world. As we agreed, you may now commission me.

180003804.text: That said, I only take commissions related to the Abyss Order.

180003805.text: Like you, I am currently on a journey. You intend to find your sibling, while I wish to oppose the Abyss.

180003806.text: Well, I have met some Abyss Mages in the past...

180003807.text: Ugh... Those creatures that serve the Abyss are the fangs and claws by which the Order spreads chaos in this world.

180003808.text: I have come to Mondstadt this time while on the trail of an Abyss Herald...

180003810.text: An even more twisted Abyssal being, one that commands the Abyss Mages.

180003811.text: Come to think of it, since the Stormterror incident ended, we haven't...

180003812.text: Ooh, that's right! We've just been fighting against the Fatui in Liyue, who are human too...

180003813.text: We haven't encountered the non-human Abyss Order at all.

180003814.text: There's some reason behind that, I'm afraid.

180003815.text: It's possible that they may have been under orders to avoid your path.

180003816.text: That does sound pretty dangerous... Maybe they're looking for a better time to ambush us or something...

180003821.text: Well then, let's go see for ourselves, shall we? According to the leads I have on hand, the Abyss Order has re-infiltrated the Temple of the Falcon.

180003822.text: Let's meet up at the temple. Perhaps your questions about the Abyss will be answered there.

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the Temple of the Falcon

180000601.text: This abandoned temple does bear some marks of the Abyss.

180000602.text: The Falcon of the West... though it can soar in the wind, it ultimately does naught but hover under the light of the gods...

180000604.text: Mm? Oh, it's nothing. Let's head inside.

subQuests.subQuestName: Enter the Temple of the Falcon

180000902.text: We found lots of signs of the Abyss Order...

180000903.text: I searched around these parts and found some signs myself.

180000904.text: But they were left behind by Abyss Mages, and there was no deeper Abyssal power to them.

180000905.text: It seems that even an Abyss Herald would not wish to make trouble with the Wolf King of the North.

180000906.text: We should leave as well. If there's anything praiseworthy about that old wolf, it's his territorial nature.

180000907.text: But now we're out of leads. Are we going to have to give up?

180000908.text: No, there is one more place we can go.

180000909.text: Let's get a move on, then. I'll wait for you at Stormterror's Lair.

180001001.text: Huh... I wonder what trouble this stranger brings with him...

180000701.text: Just a few Abyss Mages? Seems like that Herald might have already left.

180000702.text: Could you tell me more about the Abyss Order?

180000704.text: It is chaos, and it is also destruction. It is a morass of inconceivable madness that encroaches upon this world's very foundations.

180000705.text: That... is why even the Dragon of the East, a servant of a deity, was unable to resist its corrosive powers.

180000706.text: And the creatures of the Abyss desire nothing less than the overthrow of a world ruled by the archons.

180000707.text: You seem to know a lot about the Abyss, Dain.

180000708.text: Haha, well, we do have... some history.

180000709.text: I suppose that's as far as chit-chat goes. We should head to Wolvendom.

180000710.text: Judging by the traces I'm following, their next appearance may be within the territory of that old wolf.

180000711.text: Perhaps we may find our Abyss Herald there.

subQuests.subQuestName: Leave the Temple of the Falcon

180002101.text: So in the end, we still couldn't find that Abyss Herald. Bummer.

180002103.text: I wouldn't call not having to gaze upon such a creature a "shame," exactly. Still, I do believe that you will come across one eventually.

180002104.text: N—No... You're right. If it's a really powerful monster, it would be best to go around it...

180002105.text: *sigh* How good it would be if all perils one encounters in their journeys could simply be solved by going around them.

180002108.text: Once upon a time, yes... I simply have experience from adventuring together with that traveling companion.

180002109.text: Uh, you know, Dain, you keep talking about that person this, and that person that...

180002113.text: I'm afraid that traveling can be... too exhausting at times.

180002114.text: Oh, is that how it is... Well, why are you traveling alone, then?

180002115.text: I... still have some things left unfinished. Once they are done, I too will return home to rest.

180002116.text: Yup, and it's good to have a home to come back to, isn't it? We camp out a lot when we travel.

180002117.text: #Hey {NICKNAME}, once you find your sibling, we should find a place to stay too, shouldn't we?

180002118.text: Hmm... Mondstadt's Fisherman's Toast is pretty tasty, but Liyue's Wanmin Restaurant is great too...

180002119.text: Eh, either way, we should settle down in a place where there's good food!

180002120.text: Getting a bit ahead of ourselves, I think...

180002122.text: Well, it won't be too late to think about where you stay once your journey reaches its end.

180002123.text: While you're still traveling, you should...

180002124.text: ...I sense something familiar. On that cliff.

180002126.text: I felt it for a moment the previous time we came here, too...

180002127.text: A familiar feeling, you say? It could be someone you know well, or perhaps a monster.

180002129.text: Whichever it is, we should see it for ourselves, and thus see clearly.

180002130.text: We can reach the top of that cliff from over there. Let's go.

180001101.text: Do those forging materials even exist...

180000801.text: Lord of Wolvendom, Great Wolf King of the North...

180000802.text: Sharp of fang and keen of claw, and yet dwelling here only...

180000805.text: No, nor does it know me.

180000806.text: I only know these things because a previous traveling companion of mine once wanted to hear its story.

180000807.text: Alright, let's go see if that Abyss Herald has stopped by here.

180000808.text: But where do we begin? ...Hmm, are you standing here because of these strange bonfires, Dain?

180000809.text: Indeed. See that, floating above the flames? It's an Abyssal spell.

180000810.text: Knowing what I do of the Order's habits, they've probably left similar marks behind elsewhere. Let's have a look nearby.

subQuests.subQuestName: Look for clues related to the Abyss Order in Wolvendom

180001201.text: That customer will most likely be here tonight. You can wait on the second floor until he arrives.

subQuests.subQuestName: Look for clues related to the Abyss Order in Wolvendom

180001401.text: So, their reach extends here, too... Let's have a closer look.

180001501.text: I've heard about what happened to you during Mondstadt's crisis. When you came, this place was known as Stormterror's Lair.

180001502.text: But I suppose that this place is more "lair" than "Stormterror" at this point.

180001503.text: In fact, if my memory serves, this ruin has had largely nothing to do with that dragon for a long time.

180001504.text: The first time I laid eyes upon the ruins of Old Mondstadt, the Dragon of the East had yet to fall, much less come to nest in this place.

180001505.text: Huh? But Paimon remembers that Dvalin first got in trouble hundreds of years ago...

180001506.text: Don't think too much about it.

180001507.text: Do you remember the Light Actuators that once sealed this ruin?

180001508.text: If the Abyss Order is interested in this location, then they will not neglect those mechanisms.

180001509.text: Let's go see what the situation is at those Light Actuators.

180002201.text: Can you still sense that familiar feeling that you spoke of earlier?

180002203.text: But... it doesn't feel like there's anything around here. No monsters, no people, nothing.

180002204.text: Indeed, there doesn't seem to be anything strange about this place. It doesn't look any different from the last time I was here...

180002207.text: My traveling companion brought me here on our previous journey.

180002208.text: So, Dain, what about you? What's your favorite place?

180002210.text: I merely followed my traveling companion around on that journey. That's all there was to it.

180002401.text: What's gotten into you? You were just spacing out!

180002405.text: But, how could that be... You only touched that dandelion for a second!

180002406.text: Yes, the moment I touched it...

180002408.text: Perhaps that dandelion bears some sort of "scent" that only you recognize.

180002409.text: As for why... has it perhaps experienced something related to you?

180002410.text: Uh, you're saying some real confusing stuff. Paimon doesn't get it at all...

180002411.text: Regardless, I have to get to the bottom of th—!

180002413.text: Vexation and anxiety are the enemy of rational thought. Your journey has only just begun, has it not?

180002414.text: #At least you now know that {M#she}{F#he} is still on this world.

180002415.text: #At this time, the most important thing is the journey to find {M#her}{F#him} itself.

180002417.text: Yes, and this is something you must keep in mind as the meaning behind your journey.

180002418.text: May you find your kin at the end of that journey. Well then, let us part ways here for now.

180002420.text: Only for now. Don't worry, we will meet again.

180002421.text: After all... I did take 500 Mora... and those three answers you gave me.
